# Abomination trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyAbomination | Source: Abomination | Usage: Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Abomination trophy is a rare drop from Abominations in the Swamp.

### Crafting

• Sticky fishing bait

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies
